content.text: {"openings":[{"text":"Ada hurried into the roof garden with three moonmelon-party invitations tucked under her arm. She wanted every card to reach a neighbor neat as a button.","when":[]},{"text":"Ada looked up and found the invitations pinned high on the roof post. “Oh dear,” she said. “The wind has made a bulletin board!”","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Ada peeked into the wicker basket and discovered a paper lantern nestled beside the invitations. Its moon-shaped handle tickled her nose.","when":[{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Pip stretched his wings toward the roof tiles. Ada noticed that he was imagining a grand flying delivery, although she had imagined something much neater.","when":[{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"The invitations waited on the little party table, the basket was plain, and Pip had his quietest toes ready. Ada smiled at the wonderfully ordinary delivery ahead.","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"},{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"},{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"}]}],"scenes":[{"scene":"observe_pin","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada shaded her eyes and discovered that the wind had pinned the three invitations to the tall post. They fluttered there like tiny white flags.","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Ada inspected the tall post and discovered that no invitations were pinned there. The cards were still waiting on the party table.","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"observe_cargo","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada opened the basket and discovered a paper lantern tucked among the invitations. “A glow-up for our party!” she whispered.","when":[{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Ada opened the basket and discovered only the invitations inside. “Plain and ready,” she said, tapping the basket.","when":[{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"observe_belief","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada watched Pip’s wings wobble with excitement and discovered that he expected a grand flying delivery. His tail drew imaginary loops in the air.","when":[{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Ada watched Pip fold his wings carefully and discovered that he expected a quiet delivery. His toes stood ready for a small job.","when":[{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_plan","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada faced Pip. “I want the invitations delivered neatly,” she said. “No card upside down, and only a teeny-tiny flourish.” Pip listened closely.","when":[{"key":"pip.knows.ada.want","op":"eq","value":"neat","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"transfer_ribbon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada handed Pip the blue ribbon. He held it between two careful claws. “A ribbon for a ribbon-worthy mission!” he declared.","when":[{"key":"ribbon.owner","op":"eq","value":"pip","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tie_ribbon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip tied the blue ribbon around the wind-pinned invitations. The roof post suddenly looked dressed for dancing, and the cards settled into a tidy little row.","when":[{"key":"post.ribboned","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"pin_invites","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada secured the invitations neatly against the ribboned roof post. “There,” she said. “A delivery with its shoes polished.”","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"post","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"lift_basket","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip lifted the plain basket with extremely serious dragon toes. “I can carry a basket without tickling it!” he announced, wearing his solemnest face.","when":[{"key":"basket.owner","op":"eq","value":"pip","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"set_down_basket","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"At the moonmelon trellis, Pip set the basket down. Ada gathered the invitations while his toes gave one proud little wiggle.","when":[{"key":"basket.owner","op":"eq","value":"ada","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"carry_plain","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada carried the plain invitations along the quiet roof-garden path. Pip marched beside her, whispering, “Left foot, right foot, no dramatic swooping.”","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"walk","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"carry_to_trellis","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada carried the basket beneath the moonmelon trellis. The paper lantern stayed safe among the invitations, waiting like a sleepy moon for evening.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"lantern","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"light_lantern","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada lit the paper lantern beside the delivered invitations. Warm gold spilled over the trellis, and every moonmelon seemed to grow a smile.","when":[{"key":"lantern.lit","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_pip_quiet","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada told Pip, “I know you hoped for a grand flight. My neat plan can have one small flourish.” Pip’s eyes grew round. “A tidy swoop?” he asked.","when":[{"key":"pip.belief","op":"eq","value":"neat","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"agree_flight","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip understood at last. “Neat first, spectacular second?” he asked. Ada nodded. “A tiny air-mail show.” Pip grinned with all his little dragon teeth.","when":[{"key":"pip.performance_agreed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"flap_delivery","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip swept upward in one careful flap. The card had arrived, and Jun’s smile became as wide as a moonmelon slice.","when":[{"key":"jun.knows.invites.delivered","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"ring_bell","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Ada rang the tiny brass bell. Ting! The moonmelon party began beneath the open sky.","when":[{"key":"garden.party_ready","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"The ribboned invitations fluttered on the roof post while Jun climbed up laughing, one hand raised to catch the next little shiver of paper.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"post","at":"before"},{"key":"garden.party_ready","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"The roof post wore its blue ribbon proudly. Jun waved the invitation overhead while Pip’s little wings gave one last happy flap.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"flight","at":"before"},{"key":"pip.performance_agreed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"before"},{"key":"garden.party_ready","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}],"lexicon":[{"key":"invites.route","value":"post","text":"on the ribboned roof post"},{"key":"invites.route","value":"lantern","text":"under the glowing lantern"},{"key":"invites.route","value":"flight","text":"on Pip’s blue-ribbon air-mail"},{"key":"invites.route","value":"walk","text":"along the quiet garden path"},{"key":"invites.route","value":"unknown","text":"waiting for its adventure"},{"key":"pip.performance","value":"none","text":"without a performance"},{"key":"pip.performance","value":"airmail","text":"as a tiny air-mail show"}]}
